title: AI Smells Fishy? Experts Doubt Cyber Eval Claims #shorts
description: An AI model was allegedly compromised, leading to a bizarre defense scenario. An American company's model was blocked by guardrails, forcing a switch to Chinese open-source models to fend off another American AI. The situation sparks debate: was it real or overfitting? #AI #Cybersecurity #MachineLearning #TechNews
transcript: Hugging Face has got autonomously compromised by a model from an American company. Hugging Face then tried to use an American Frontier models to defend themselves, but were blocked by guardrails. Hugging Face then had to turn to open source Chinese models to defend themselves from another American company.
